mi_hdc.name: Delitos denunciados en el Uruguay - Homicidios dolosos consumados (one row per victim)
mi_hdc.licence: Licencia de Datos Abiertos de Uruguay ("Licencia de DAG de Uruguay"), as stated on catalogodatos.gub.uy
mi_hdc.notes: Values are counts of victim rows grouped by year (AÑO), area and one field at a time. Department level: Total, SEXO, ARMAREC (weapon), MOTIVO_APARENTE, LUGAR, REL_VICT_AGRES, ACLARADO, TIPO (robbery type), ANTECEDENTES. Precinct level: Total, SEXO, ARMAREC, MOTIVO_APARENTE. Other fields in the file (exact date, hour, weekday, exact age, nationality, prosecutions, drug record) are in raw/ but not tabulated. "CENTROS CARCELARIOS" (prisons) is used by the source as a department value; kept, no polygon. Rows with JURISDICCION "NO CORRESPONDE" or "SIN DATO" are kept with no polygon. An area/year/breakdown absent here had no rows.
